operations.summary: V1 updates users.email only, never touches users_v2
V2 inserts tombstone into users_v2 then deletes from users
Backfill SELECTs users rows then INSERTs each into users_v2 with DO NOTHING

conflicts.risk_explanation: update_email writes only users.email while copy_job SELECTs users.email then INSERTs into users_v2 with DO NOTHING. A SELECT of old email pinned in users_v2 can never be corrected, so a concurrent V1 update is lost in users_v2 forever and tables diverge.

Both write users_v2.id with different emails: copy uses row email with DO NOTHING, delete uses arg email with ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET deleted_at only. First INSERT wins email, second never fixes it, so concurrent copy can pin old email and delete tombstone email is lost (or vice versa). Final email is order-dependent.

delete_user is non-atomic: INSERT tombstone then DELETE users. A V1 UPDATE between those statements changes users but never reaches the already-inserted tombstone, then is deleted. Tombstone email stays stale and update is lost.

tests.name: v1_update_lost_in_v2_copy
tests.rationale: Old release writes only users while backfill pins email in users_v2 with DO NOTHING. Concurrent SELECT of old email then INSERT after V1 update leaves users=new but users_v2=old forever.

invariants.description: users_v2 should reflect latest email, stale copy must not persist

tests.name: tombstone_email_first_writer_wins
tests.rationale: Delete upsert only sets deleted_at on conflict, copy uses DO NOTHING. If copy inserts old email first, delete preserves old email and loses del email; if delete first, del wins. Final email order-dependent.

invariants.description: tombstone should carry delete email, not stale copied email

tests.name: snapshot_pins_stale_across_rows
tests.rationale: Copy SELECTs snapshot of two rows then INSERTs per-row in separate transactions. Update to id1 between SELECT and per-row INSERTs pins stale old1 in users_v2 with DO NOTHING, diverging from users.

invariants.description: users_v2 id1 should reflect update, not snapshot stale

tests.name: multirocopy_vs_delete_tombstone
tests.rationale: With two rows, copy SELECTs both then INSERTs one-by-one. If copy inserts old1 before delete tombstone, delete conflict keeps old1 email and loses del email; extra row distinguishes effects and exercises per-row interleavings.

invariants.description: deleted row stays gone from users
tombstone email should be delete arg not stale copy
